subject: english
question:
In the following sentence, four words are given in underlined out of which one word is misspelt. Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

And so he __was__ (A), for, as she __laughed__ (B) and talked, Jo had __whiskd__ (C) things into place and given __quite__ (D) a different air to the room.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"whiskd"** is misspelt.
 
• The correct spelling is "**whisked**".
 
 
• **Meaning:** To move or cause to move quickly. (तेजी से हिलाना)
 
• **Example:** She **whisked **the eggs to make a fluffy omelette.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **A (was)**: Used to indicate a past state or condition.

 
 
• **Example:** He **was **very happy with his new job.
 
 
 
• **B (laughed)**: To make sounds and movements of the face and body that show amusement.
 
 
• **Example:** She **laughed **at the funny joke.
 
 
 
• **D (quite)**: To the utmost or most absolute extent or degree; absolutely; completely.
 
 
• **Example:** The presentation was **quite **impressive.
